gates.name: Primary Artifact & Commit Lock
gates.check: Frozen git commit + SHA-256/BLAKE3 paper & receipt pin + claim-ledger.json status-word licence check

gates.name: Structured Source-Sheet Extraction
gates.check: Every spoken takeaway mapped 1:1 to primary paper section, figure/table, and orthogonal energy class

gates.name: ISO 24495-1:2023 Plain-Language Script Gate
gates.check: 3-point plain-word opening across 15s/45s/90s/180s; zero unexplained acronyms; 5-reader panel protocol queued

gates.name: W3C COGA 8-Objective & Easy-Read Gate
gates.check: One idea per sentence + Mulberry & Tawasol (CC BY-SA 4.0) AAC symbol mappings; zero embedded NC pictograms

gates.name: Clean-Licence Open-Weight MT Gate
gates.check: Apache-2.0 MADLAD-400 translation pipeline; zero CC-BY-NC MT/TTS weights in published outputs

gates.name: Dual Neural Semantic & Round-Trip Gate
gates.check: LaBSE + multilingual-e5 cosine + back-translation chrF++ >= 38.0 with 2-strike automatic quarantine

gates.name: Numerical & Energy-Class Invariance Gate
gates.check: numbers_exact == true; measured_j ⊥ reported_j ⊥ est_j ⊥ unmetered never summed or cross-ratioed

gates.name: Broadcast Loudness & Low-Bitrate Codec Gate
gates.check: -16 LUFS stereo AAC (.m4a), -14 LUFS 9:16 vertical MP4, <1 MB mobile MP4, and 24 kbps Opus

gates.name: Independent ASR Round-Trip Verifier
gates.check: Whisper-large-v3-turbo (MIT) independent transcription WER & spoken-number match

gates.name: Multimodal Accessibility Gate
gates.check: WCAG 2.2 AA captions, Voiced AD (.ad.m4a + .ad-mix.m4a), Surrey Accessible Cues, and zero-table Braille HTML

gates.name: Media Production J/min Metering Gate
gates.check: Per-variant production J/min stamped by orthogonal evidence class (Thor INA238 / KV260 INA260 measured_j vs L4 reported_j vs unmetered)

gates.name: Cryptographic WAI1 & Ed25519 Signature
gates.check: Deterministic BLAKE3-256 content digest + Ed25519 signature under Signed Provenance · Self-Checked

gates.name: Open-Archive & Multi-Channel Readiness
gates.check: CC-BY-4.0 media + CC0-1.0 metadata, Zenodo IsVariantFormOf/IsTranslationOf, IA + Wikimedia Commons, YouTube auto-dub OFF, TikTok source-sheet link

energy_accounting.study_energy_disclosure: Board power shunts on Tegra kit plus chip counters on four hosts; never summed.

claims.statement: Changing the wrapper around an AI model can swing scores as much as swapping the model.
This test harness locks prompts, memory trimming, and tools so every AI takes the exact same exam.
Across five computer types, it separates real board sensors from chip counters and blocks noisy power estimates.
claims.paper_section: 2. Survey of Agent Harnesses and Why Context Policy Is Part of the System

Changing the wrapper around an AI model can swing scores as much as swapping the model.
This test harness locks prompts, memory trimming, and tools so every AI takes the exact same exam.
